description:
Low Poly model of American Sport sedan of the 00s. Essentially an improved version of my old model. I enlarged the arches, adjusted the profile and lines of the car to my taste, realizing a more squat silhouette. The model has Unwrapped UVs, a simple interior and engine, but the doors do not open.

I unconditionally give you permission to use this model at your discretion, modify it or implement it into a digital product. Use the model as you see fit and have a nice day.
